name: Reynard Soft7 777 #76 · The Seventh Flame
description: Reynard Soft7 777. Card 76 of 777, wave 1. The Seventh Flame: a fox war-mage of the Seventh Gate, painted for battle under the phoenix. From the world of Reynard Soft7: the foxes and tigers of the Seventh Gate, the phoenix above them and the titans behind them. Built on Robinhood Chain, not a Robinhood product.
